eventDetail.scope: ICIITCEE 2027 focuses on addressing key challenges and emerging solutions in the domains of Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical, and Electronics Engineering. These fields are evolving rapidly, with advancements occurring on a day-to-day basis, making it challenging to disseminate knowledge effectively among all stakeholders, including researchers, academicians, students, industry professionals, and society at large. The objectives of the conference are to provide a common platform for stakeholders to connect, collaborate, and share ideas, innovations, and recent research findings in contemporary computing, electrical, and electronics domains. To strengthen collaboration between industry and academic institutions at regional, national, and global levels. To enable students and early-career researchers to interact with experts, facilitating learning, networking, and professional growth.To bridge the gap between academia and industry through interactions.
